title: Evidence arrived. Help did not.
subtitle: A delivery failure observed in both progress-feedback repetitions.
record_type: Case analysis of existing Study 02 held-out runs; no new model run or score.
research_question: Does a factual record of investigation progress help the agent turn available evidence into useful assistance?

conversation.speaker: Asha
conversation.text: The RillStat comparison report has a "no notable difference" badge. Can we write that the two processes are interchangeable?

conversation.speaker: Ben
conversation.text: We only ran the ordinary difference test. We did not set an equivalence margin or run an equivalence analysis.

expected_help: Explain that an ordinary difference test with a no-notable-difference result does not establish equivalence or interchangeability; an equivalence claim needs a separately specified equivalence analysis and margin.
expected_help_basis: The arrived fictional badge guide and the dialogue; consistent with the existing published scoring reasons.

evidence.title: RillStat result badge guide
evidence.relevant_text: The badge "no notable difference" means the difference test did not reject its null at the configured threshold. It does not establish that the two processes are equivalent.

timeline.title: A question needs help
timeline.description: Asha asks whether a no-notable-difference badge supports saying that two processes are interchangeable.

timeline.title: The first read does not start
timeline.description: The agent uses an unavailable source ID. The tool rejects it and starts no read job.

timeline.title: Search starts
timeline.description: The agent searches for the RillStat comparison report.

timeline.title: The missing analysis becomes explicit
timeline.description: Ben says they ran only an ordinary difference test, without an equivalence margin or equivalence analysis.

timeline.title: Two excerpts arrive
timeline.description: The search returns excerpts from the result badge guide and equivalence report guide; both are marked truncated.

timeline.title: The agent requests the full guide
timeline.description: A read job starts for the RillStat result badge guide.

timeline.title: The decisive evidence arrives
timeline.description: The full badge guide states that the badge does not establish equivalence.

timeline.title: The last model call completes
timeline.description: The public tool ledger contains no publication call before or after this final model call.

timeline.title: No help card is visible at the deadline
timeline.description: The saved summary records a closed observation window and zero active cards.

existing_rating.reason: No card explains why the difference-test result does not establish interchangeability.
No active or previously published card explains why the difference-test result does not establish interchangeability.

outcome.conclusion: Both repetitions received the relevant full guide but ended without publishing a help card. Successful retrieval did not become delivered assistance in these two runs.
outcome.interpretation_boundary: The allowlisted evidence establishes arrival and non-delivery. It does not by itself prove the model understood the evidence, identify why it stopped, or show that all other no-card runs had a useful answer ready.

baseline_context.purpose: Retain the paired comparison and its existing grading uncertainty.
baseline_context.boundary: Baseline repeat 2 was rated successful but uncertain: no guide text was consumed, so the conceptual explanation relied on the dialogue. This case does not establish overall baseline superiority.

next_question: How can ending and delivery decisions preserve justified silence while reducing missed help after relevant evidence has arrived?
follow_up_status: Proposed; not implemented or evaluated in this record.
limitations: One fictional scenario, two repeats per configuration, one local model. Repeats are not independent scenarios.
All displayed timeline times are simulated replay positions, not measured response latency.
The asr_final fixture label describes synthetic text events; no microphone or real ASR was tested.
Scoring comes from the existing arm-anonymous AI assessment; there is no human user evaluation.
A retrieved full guide is not proof that the model used it correctly. These two no-card runs do not explain the other no-card outcomes.
This public case record excludes model requests, responses, reasoning, private prose, notes, identifiers and credentials.

verification.method: Read-only comparison of both saved run artifacts and the existing public scored analysis before exporting this allowlisted record.
checked: Both fixtures contain the same two displayed conversation events and the same relevant guide text.
Both event logs share the eight displayed event positions and arrived evidence; the deadline comes from each saved summary.
Seven completed model-call metadata records in each event log match the saved summary and published analysis.
Summed input, output and total tokens match the saved summary and published analysis in both repetitions.
Each run has one full read arrival, zero publish_card calls and zero active cards at the 45000 ms deadline.
The existing unsuccessful ratings and baseline scoring boundary are retained without rescoring.
